title: Week 11 Primetime Receipts & Grading
subtitle: Origin slate that sparked NFL Game Scout: SNF Mexico City (35-10 + 71-yard Fair-Catch Free Kick!) and MNF Bengals at Commanders.

away.name: Minnesota Vikings
away.qb: Kirk Cousins (2nd start back in Minnesota after deadline trade; Kyler Murray out w/ hamstring)

kicker.name: Will Reichard
kicker.note: Attempted a 71-yard fair-catch free kick at 0:03 Q2 that traveled dead center and fell 1 yard short.

home.name: San Francisco 49ers
home.qb: Brock Purdy (10/12, 166 yds, 3 TDs, 158.3 RTG in 1st half alone)

venue.quirk: 7,350+ ft elevation adds +6-8 yds kicking carry and taxes recovery between snaps; SF acclimated all week in Colorado Springs while MIN stayed in a custom facility chamber.

weather.physicsNote: Calm wind + thin 7,350-ft air unlocked 70-yard field-goal carry.

away: QB Kyler Murray (hamstring), WR Jordan Addison (thumb), CB Isaiah Rodgers (quad), S Jay Ward (knee) all INACTIVE; S Theo Jackson injured in Q2.
home: LB Dre Greenlaw (neck) INACTIVE; WR Mike Evans (Achilles) & WR Deebo Samuel ACTIVE.

referee.flagsPerGame: 16.7 accepted penalties/gm (141 yds/gm; +4.3 vs NFL avg)
tendencies: Strict rule-enforcer on offensive/defensive holding, false starts, and roughing the passer.
Swallows whistle slightly in final 2 minutes.
referee.tonightImpact: Flags spiked in late Q2 (16-yd Purdy intentional grounding + SF holding wiping out 47-yd punt return), directly creating the 71-yd fair-catch free-kick window.

why: Brian Flores' #1 scoring defense (14.0 PPG) forcing Purdy into turnovers.
Kirk Cousins rekindling Justin Jefferson targets without Dre Greenlaw in the middle.
how: Keep score under 20, control clock with Aaron Jones & Jordan Mason, avoid 3rd-and-long vs Bosa/Buckner.

why: Mike Evans & Deebo Samuel returning alongside George Kittle & CMC vs. Minnesota's depleted DBs (Rodgers & Ward out).
Raheem Morris defense with Fred Warner, Nick Bosa, DeForest Buckner shutting down one-dimensional Addison-less offense.
how: Strike early through Evans & Kittle, force Minnesota behind by two scores, pin ears back on Cousins.

sentiment30d.awayVibe: Optimism around Kirk Cousins' deadline return & 30-10 win over GB.
sentiment30d.homeVibe: Confidence after 584-yard shootout win over Dallas and Colorado Springs camp cohesion.
sentiment30d.awayBeat: 72% public spread tickets on MIN +3.5; altitude fly-in/fly-out strategy debated.
sentiment30d.homeBeat: Sharp 56% handle on SF -3.5; Evans return hyped.
sentiment30d.marketSplit: Public liked MIN +3.5 (72% tickets); sharp money backed SF -3.5 (56% handle).
sentiment30d.contrarianTakeaway: Sharp handle beat public tickets easily as SF cruised 35-10.

tiers.impact: DeForest Buckner midseason addition & Evans/Deebo depth overwhelmed MIN's depleted DB room.

tiers.homeStaff: Kyle Shanahan (HC), Klay Kubiak (OC), Raheem Morris (DC)
tiers.impact: Shanahan dismantled Flores' missing-DB secondary early before Raheem Morris closed the door.
SF passing weapons dominated Minnesota's backup defensive backs.
SF's Colorado Springs week paid off as their older core (26.9 avg) pulled away 35-10.

crossStaffTells: Kirk Cousins had literally just faced SF's defense weeks earlier as Las Vegas Raiders QB.
orgChart.hiddenMismatch: 49ers pass catchers & medical return staff (Evans/Kittle) vs. Vikings DB room missing Rodgers, Ward, and Q2-injured Theo Jackson.

modelMeta.exclusionReason: Origin demo — 35-10 score was refined at halftime rather than locked pre-kickoff

predictions.primaryKey: Evans & Kittle shredding Minnesota's missing DBs while SF's pass rush forces Cousins into negative plays.
predictions.refCall: Alex Moore (16.7 flags/gm) — Q2 flags flipped field position and created the 0:03 free-kick chance.
predictions.sentimentEdge: Sharp handle on SF -3.5 vs public MIN tickets.
predictions.hiddenMismatch: SF returning WRs vs. MIN backup secondary.

surpriseCall.title: 68-70 Yard Mexico City Record Threat / Fair-Catch Free Kick
surpriseCall.detail: Pegged Will Reichard's exact Mexico City ceiling at 68-70 yds AND explicitly named the rare fair-catch free kick rule before Q2 ended — Reichard then attempted a 71-yard fair-catch free kick at 0:03 Q2 that missed 1 yard short of the crossbar, dead center.
ingredients: 7,350-ft Mexico City thin air (+6 to +8 yds carry)
Will Reichard 62-yd career long -> 68-70 yd ceiling
Fair-catch free-kick rule mechanic before halftime

grade.notes: Hit SF -3.5, Under 46.5 (35-10 = 45), called 35-10 script at halftime, AND nailed the 68-70 yd carry ceiling + fair-catch free-kick mechanic right before Reichard's 71-yd attempt landed 1 yd short.

result.freakPlayOutcome: At 0:03 Q2, after a Purdy intentional grounding pushed SF back, MIN called a fair catch at its 39 and Will Reichard kicked a 71-yard fair-catch free kick that sailed dead straight and fell 1 yard short of the crossbar.

away: INACTIVE: S Kyle Dugger (quad), G Dalton Risner (knee), OT Myles Hinton, TE Cam Grandy, DT Landon Robinson. (S Dax Hill & LG Dylan Fairchild ACTIVE.)
home: INACTIVE: CB Amik Robertson (ankle, late warmup scratch); LT Laremy Tunsil (triceps) & WR Terry McLaurin (IR) out. (RBs Jacory Croskey-Merritt & Rachaad White ACTIVE.)

tendencies: Famously swallows whistle on offensive holding; lets DBs hand-fight downfield.
False starts & neutral zone infractions take a larger share of calls; fast pace leans Under ~55%.
referee.tonightImpact: Low offensive-holding rate is huge help for Washington's backup LT replacing Laremy Tunsil.

why: Joe Burrow (310.6 team pass yds/gm, #1 NFL) vs. #24 WAS defense missing CB Amik Robertson.
Al Golden & Sean Desai pass rush attacking Tunsil-less Washington edge.
how: Attack outside coverage early with Chase & Higgins, build two-score lead, force McLaurin-less Washington to drop back 40+ times.

why: Jayden Daniels' legs & ball security (2 INTs) vs CIN defense allowing 340+ yds/gm.
Bengals #30 rushing attack (84.8 yds/gm) + Daronte Jones coaching under Zac Taylor in 2019.
how: Control clock via Daniels & Anthony Lynn's RBs, steal possessions on 4th downs, lean on Vinovich holding leeway.

surpriseCall.title: Tress Way Farewell Fake-Punt Pass (or Fake-FG Throw)
surpriseCall.detail: In the rematch of the 2024 zero-punt game, retiring 13th-year punter Tress Way executes a 4th-down fake-punt throw for Dan Quinn to steal a possession against Joe Burrow with Vinovich swallowing his whistle on borderline blocking.
ingredients: Tress Way playing in his likely final 13th NFL season
Dan Quinn +6.5 home underdog desperation vs 31+ PPG Bengals

bonusSleeper.title: Defensive 2-Point Conversion Return ('Pick-Two')
bonusSleeper.detail: Late 54-point shootout 2-point try gets picked/scooped and returned the other way for a 3-point swing.

grade.notes: Missed WAS +6.5 outright upset (22-20 on rookie Drew Stevens' walk-off FG) and Under 54.0 (42 pts). Biggest lesson: Washington billed a promotional 'Blackout' night and the stadium lights literally went out in Q3 (10:00 PM vendor timer), inspiring the Narrative-First venue-promotion rule in SKILL.md.

result.summary: Washington upset Cincinnati 22-20 on rookie K Drew Stevens' walk-off field goal at 0:00, flipping 95% public ML handle on CIN and landing Under 54.0.
result.freakPlayOutcome: Mid-Q3 total stadium blackout halted play for several minutes on Washington's promotional 'Blackout' night after the lighting vendor left a 10:00 PM weekday shutoff schedule active; no Tress Way fake punt occurred.
